pages.title: Tidlo Toys General Hospital
pages.description: Tidlo Toys General Hospital 30 piece wooden playset would be the perfect setting to nurse your favourite character back to health.
pages.ld_description:
The Tidlo Toys General Hospital 30-piece wooden playset provides the perfect environment for nursing your favourite character back to health.

This comprehensive playset includes everything you need for an engaging hospital experience, featuring an air ambulance, a road ambulance, ward beds, privacy screens, surgery lights, tables, a heart monitor, an MRI scanner, and an X-ray machine. It also comes with a wheelchair and stretchers for easy movement around the hospital.

At this hospital, there are no lengthy waiting times, as doctors, nurses, paramedics, and pilots are always on call to care for the five patients.

The Tidlo Toys General Hospital is fully equipped to handle emergencies, complete with a clicking elevator, a helicopter landing pad, and an A&E ambulance drop-off point.

 	Three floors packed with play value
 	Consists of 30 play pieces.
 	Includes an air ambulance, road ambulance, ward beds, privacy screens, an MRI scanner, an X-Ray machine, doctors, nurses & more
 	A great way to encourage creative and imaginative play sessions.
 	Develops hand/eye coordination, fine motor skills and dexterity.
 	Can be combined with our other Doctor and Hospital toys for a complete play experience
 	Requires adult assembly.
 	Made from high quality, responsibly sourced materials.
 	Conforms to current European safety standards.

 

Dimensions 52.8 x 51.8 x 12.4 cm
